title: Nieman Fellowship (International, 2027-28)
institution: Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard University
about: Harvard's Nieman Foundation is accepting applications for its 2027-28 fellowships for working journalists with at least five years of full-time experience. The international application is due 1 December 2026; the U.S. deadline is 31 January 2027. Fellowships start around mid-August.
requirements: Working journalist with at least five years of full-time media experience (student journalism does not count; PR professionals excluded)
Two essays, professional profile and study proposal summary, work samples, three recommendation letters

upskill.name: AI for Documents, Reports & Presentations
why: "Two essays, professional profile and study proposal summary" → "Use AI to create and improve reports, proposals, executive summaries, briefs, and other professional documents."
"study proposal summary" → "Transform rough ideas, notes, and source materials into coherent structures with appropriate sections, arguments, and supporting information."
